_description: Curated milestone-paper list (illustrative; no longer plotted in the bibliometric figure a2_maturation_evidence, whose panels (a-c) are computed from categorization.json and ref-gem.bib). Years are the publication years of the versions cited in ref-gem.bib. Construction: (1) we ran a Semantic Scholar API query for each maturation phase with phase-appropriate keyword strings (see milestones_audit.json for the raw results); (2) we cross-referenced the API output against the canonical XAI literature surveyed in this review; (3) the API's top-cited result per query overlapped substantially with the canonical list but also produced off-topic false positives (e.g., a 2023 urban-growth XAI paper unrelated to attribution), so we kept the canonical curated list as the publication-quality milestone set, with the API audit log as a sanity check showing the procedure is reproducible. Selection criteria, citation snapshot date, and source are documented per entry. This is an exemplar list, not a systematic enumeration; the composition and trend panels (a-c) of the bibliometric figure are systematic.
citation_source: Google Scholar (curated canonical entries) + Semantic Scholar API cross-check (snapshot in milestones_audit.json)
selection_procedure: 1. Query Semantic Scholar via build_milestones_from_api.py for each phase's keyword set.
2. Save all raw API responses to milestones_audit.json for inspection.
3. Cross-check API top-results against the canonical XAI literature surveyed in Sections 3-4.

4. Where the API top-result matches a canonical paper, use the API citation count; where the API surfaces an off-topic paper, retain the canonical paper instead, with the reason documented in this file.
5. The list is intentionally bounded at ~14 entries: enough to populate three phases visually without overfitting any single sub-area.
